jobs.title: Executive Director, Technology Strategy - Business Effectiveness
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you’ll be doing**

  

We are seeking a highly skilled technologist with deep understanding of the corporate and investment banking business. As the Executive Director, Technology Strategy \- Business Effectiveness, the primary objective is to support the growth of the business by ensuring our technology systems and processes are fit for purpose, scalable, and aligned with business needs. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and partner with technology to develop and execute a technology roadmap that bridges business requirements with technological capabilities. You will help to execute Global Corporate and Investment Banking’s (‘GCIB’) strategy, aligning technology initiatives to enable GCIB to achieve its mandate, goals, and objectives. You will set strategic plans that align with GCIB’s overall vision.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. To successfully perform the work, you’ll be on\-site full\-time.*

  

**How you’ll succeed**

  

  

* **Strategic Technology \& Innovation \-** Partner with business leaders in corporate and investment banking to identify strategic technology priorities and requirements.Partner with technology to develop and maintain a comprehensive technology roadmap aligned to business growth objectives.Champion AI efforts and business adoption.Translate business needs into actionable technology solutions, ensuring timely and effective delivery.Partner with technology to lead or support initiatives to modernize platforms, integrate new technologies, and optimize workflows.Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to corporate and investment banking. Ensure technology solutions meet regulatory, risk, and security standards. Assess existing systems and processes, recommending enhancements to drive efficiency, scalability, and compliance.

* **Leadership, Relationship Management \& Collaboration \-** Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders to successfully execute initiatives and bring new clients and capabilities to market. You’ll communicate complex concepts clearly and elegantly, collaborating closely with business partners to understand their challenges by asking insightful questions and gathering necessary information. Collaborate with senior leaders across business lines, technology, risk, operations, and data teams to deliver integrated and scalable product solutions.Foster a culture of innovation, data\-driven decision making, and continuous improvement within the team.Manage, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of product strategists, transformation leaders, and data specialists.Present strategic recommendations, business cases, and transformation progress updates to executive management and relevant governance committees.
  

**Who you are**

  

  

* **You can demonstrate experience.** 12\+ years of progressive experience in corporate \& investment banking, with a focus on product strategy, transformation, or innovation. Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale transformation and change management initiatives, including data\-driven projects, within a global financial institution. Proven ability to benchmark and implement best practices from leading global banks. Experience managing and developing high\-performing teams, including product, transformation, and data professionals.
* **You can demonstrate knowledge.** Deep expertise in data modeling, taxonomy development, and data governance as applied to banking products and services. Strong knowledge of global banking products, regulatory landscape, and emerging market and technology trends.

**Who we are**
--------------


We are an organization comprised of industry thought leaders who are passionate about health data and want to make a difference in the health care field. We are an independent, not\-for\-profit organization and together with our partners we provide essential information on Canada's health systems, enabling decisions that lead to healthier Canadians. As a valued member of the CIHI team, you and your work will have a pivotal role in the evolution of Canada's health care systems.


CIHI is recognized as an eceptional place to work that embraces diversity, respect, integrity, collaboration and innovation.


At CIHI, we recognize what matters to our employees. Some of the benefits of working at CIHI include


* HOOPP Pension Plan (Defined Benefits Pension)
* Retirement Planning Program
* Generous vacation days for permanent and long\-term contracts
* Work\-life balance
* Career Planning Program
* Learning and Professional Development Program

Fle* ible benefits program from your first day on the job for permanent and long\-term contracts
**Why is this role important?**
-------------------------------


Reporting to the Vice President \& Chief Operations Officer, Business Operations Division, the Eecutive Director provides enterprise leadership and sets strategic direction for CIHI’s analytics portfolio, including how CIHI transforms data into meaningful information, insights and products that support decision\-making by governments, health systems and other stakeholders. The Eecutive Director leads the evolution and integration of analytical capabilities, methodologies and products, ensuring CIHI’s analytics remain relevant, responsive and increasingly enabled by modern analytical approaches, emerging technologies and AI.
  

  

The portfolio is focused on turning CIHI’s data into insight, intelligence and value to assess health\-system performance, inform health policy and support health\-system management. It inherently has strong interdependencies with Data Management \& Standards and Governance \& Stewardship, while maintaining its primary accountability of transforming data into meaningful information, insights and products.


**What you'll do**
------------------


1\. Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Analytics portfolio, aligned with CIHI’s mandate, strategic priorities and evolving information needs.
  

2\. Lead the development and eecution of portfolio priorities, plans and initiatives to strengthen CIHI’s analytical capabilities, products and services.
  

3\. Oversee the effective allocation of financial, human and technical resources, ensuring sustainable delivery and value for investment.
  

4\. Drive integration and collaboration across portfolios and functions, identifying and removing organizational, operational and other barriers that inhibit progress and the advancement of enterprise priorities.
  

5\. Strengthen integration across related data, analytics, technology and corporate functions and identify opportunities to improve how analytical work is coordinated and delivered across the organization.
  

6\. Provide eecutive advice on emerging opportunities, risks, priorities and decisions affecting CIHI’s analytical capabilities and longer\-term direction.
  

7\. Build strong relationships with internal and eternal partners to advance d objectives and support the relevance, adoption and impact of CIHI’s analytical work.
  

8\. Lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary team and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion and continuous improvement.
  

9\. Champion change and modernization within the portfolio, challenging established approaches where appropriate and creating the conditions for timely decision\-making, eecution and progress.


**What you'll bring to the table**
----------------------------------


* Degree in a relevant discipline including health data analytics, statistics, health, business, technology or a related field. An advanced degree is considered an asset.
* Minimum 10\-12 years of progressive eperience leading comple, enterprise\-wide portfolios, initiatives and organizational change in a leadership capacity with a focus on analytics, data, research, information or a related environment.
* Strong understanding of analytical practices and the evolving role of analytics, AI and emerging technologies in supporting organizational and health\-system priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to develop strategy, translate priorities into action and deliver results in comple and evolving environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across boundaries, manage interdependencies and enable organizational eecution.
* Strong relationship\-building, consultation, negotiation, influence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build alignment among senior leaders and diverse internal and eternal partners.
* Demonstrated judgment and decision\-making skills, with the ability to balance strategic priorities, risks, resources and operational considerations.
* Ability to fulfill travel requirements.
* Fluency in English is required, bilingualism in both official languages is an asset.

  

There are three Eecutive Director opportunities available through this competitive process. If you have applied to more than one of these opportunities, please identify your preferred position(s) of interest in your cover letter.
To find out more about this role and other eciting opportunities visit our website at www.cihi.ca and check out our 'Careers' section.

jobs.title: Senior Java Technology Developer – Vice President
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Citi is looking for a Senior Java Developer to take technical ownership of business\-critical Credit Risk and Capital Markets platforms, driving the modernization of large\-scale systems into resilient, cloud\-native architectures. In this Vice President\-level role, you will operate as a senior individual contributor and technical leader — shaping engineering standards, guiding platform evolution, and delivering high\-impact solutions across a globally distributed team. If you bring deep Java expertise, Capital Markets domain knowledge, and a drive to solve complex engineering challenges at scale, this role offers the scope and influence to make a real difference**.**


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Design and deliver high\-performance, enterprise\-scale Credit Risk and Capital Markets systems across the full software development lifecycle, from architecture through production deployment.
* Lead the re\-engineering of complex, monolithic applications into modern, cloud\-native microservices, ensuring scalability, resilience, and regulatory compliance at every stage.
* Define and drive architectural decisions for platform modernization initiatives, including cloud migration and the adoption of distributed data processing technologies.
* Build and sustain low\-latency, highly available systems that meet enterprise\-grade standards for security, performance, and operational stability.
* Partner with a global team of software engineers, business analysts, DevOps, and support functions to deliver quality solutions across Capital Markets and Risk domains.
* Mentor and develop mid\-level and junior engineers, raising engineering standards and enabling the team to consistently deliver production\-grade solutions.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies — including AI\-assisted development tooling — to improve engineering efficiency and delivery quality.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
-------------------------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in application development or systems analysis, with a track record of delivering large\-scale, complex technology initiatives.
* Deep expertise in Core Java, including object\-oriented design principles, concurrent and multi\-threaded programming, JVM memory management, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience re\-engineering monolithic applications into microservices architectures, and deploying containerised workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Practical knowledge of distributed systems and data processing frameworks such as Apache Flink, alongside distributed caching technologies such as Redis, Oracle Coherence, or GridGain.
* Database experience spanning relational platforms (preferably Oracle) and NoSQL technologies (preferably MongoDB), with the ability to design for scale and reliability.
* Proven domain knowledge in Capital Markets, including Derivatives, Credit Risk, and Risk Management, with experience supporting risk\-sensitive, business\-critical platforms.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent practical experience in a comparable role.

**Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications**
---------------------------------------


* Experience with SDLC and DevOps tooling including Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, SonarQube, and JIRA, with familiarity in secure coding practices.
* Familiarity with Linux and Unix environments, including scripting for automation and operational tasks.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Devin to accelerate engineering delivery.
* Recognised subject matter expertise in one or more areas of application development, with a demonstrated ability to influence architectural and strategic decisions at a senior level.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


At Citi, you will work at the intersection of technology and financial markets, contributing to platforms that directly support global Capital Markets operations. This is a senior role with real ownership, strategic influence, and the opportunity to shape how critical systems are built and modernised across a high\-performing global engineering team.


* Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you flexibility alongside meaningful in\-person collaboration.
* Opportunity to lead technically significant, franchise\-critical initiatives with direct impact on Credit Risk and Capital Markets infrastructure at global scale.
* Access to continuous learning and professional development resources to deepen both technical and domain expertise.
* A performance\-driven environment where senior engineers have genuine influence over architectural direction and technology strategy.
* Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial wellbeing and long\-term career growth.
* Wellbeing support and work\-life balance initiatives, backed by programmes tailored to the needs of experienced technology professionals.

Apply now to bring your Java engineering expertise to one of the world's leading financial institutions and take technical ownership of platforms that matter**.**

The Director, Enterprise Applications is responsible for leading the strategy, lifecycle, and continuous improvement of Gateway’s core enterprise application portfolio. This role oversees a team of product managers and technical specialists accountable for business\-critical platforms including Financial Systems, HRIS, Gaming Management Systems (GMS), and other operational and corporate applications.


This leader will act as the primary bridge between the business and technology, ensuring applications deliver measurable value, align with enterprise strategy, and evolve in step with regulatory, operational, and business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy \& Portfolio Ownership**

* Own the enterprise product strategy for Gateway’s core application portfolio, including financial, HR, gaming, and operational systems.
* Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business priorities, operational requirements, and technology standards.
* Balance enhancement demand, technical health, regulatory requirements, and vendor roadmaps across multiple platforms.
* Establish clear product vision, outcomes, and success measures for each application domain.

**Product Delivery \& Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the full product lifecycle from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and optimization.
* Partner with Architecture, Security, and IT Operations to ensure scalable, secure, and supportable solutions.
* Drive adoption, change readiness, and continuous improvement post?implementation.

**Business \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a senior point of accountability for business leaders across Finance, Human Resources, Casino Operations, Compliance, and corporate functions.
* Facilitate structured intake and prioritization of business demands using transparent, outcome?based decisioning.
* Translate business needs into actionable product requirements and trade?off recommendations.
* Communicate product roadmap status, risks, and value realization to executives and senior leadership.

**Vendor \& Platform Management**

* Oversee strategic vendor relationships for enterprise platforms, including product roadmap alignment and performance management.
* Partner with Procurement and Legal on contract negotiations, renewals, and cost optimization.
* Ensure vendor solutions meet Gateway’s operational, regulatory, security, and scalability requirements.

**People Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers across multiple application domains.
* Establish consistent product management practices, standards, and governance.
* Build strong domain expertise within the team while maintaining enterprise alignment.
* Support talent development, succession planning, and performance management.

**What You Bring**

* 10\+ years of experience in technology, product management, or enterprise application leadership is required.
* 5\+ years in a senior leadership role managing product managers or application portfolios is required.
* Proven experience owning and evolving enterprise platforms (Finance, HRIS, ERP, or regulated industry systems) is necessary.

* Exposure to modern product management practices is required.
* Familiarity with Gaming Management Systems (GMS) or other mission critical operational platforms is preferred.
* Experience balancing competing priorities across complex, multi business environments is preferred.
* Experience in gaming, hospitality, retail, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience operating in a multi site, 24/7 environment is preferred.

Gateway Casinos \& Entertainment Limited (“Gateway”) is one of the largest and most diversified gaming and entertainment companies in Canada with 31 gaming properties in British Columbia, Ontario and Alberta. Across its entire portfolio, Gateway currently employs approximately 7,200 people and features approximately 391 table games (including 31 poker tables), 14,288 slots, 81 food and beverage outlets and 564 hotel rooms.


Gateway has been in the business of gaming and entertainment in Canada for more than thirty years and continues to evolve and expand its renowned offerings, including developing casino and restaurant brands. The Gateway to Your Future starts with us.

A career at Gateway means working with great people, being recognized for your unique contribution and career advancement opportunities across our 31 locations. Our employees thrive with ongoing training and leadership programs while working in a dynamic and fun environment. See for yourself what it’s like to be on a team that values your vision, skill and energy.
